title: billing.credit
description: Payload for the billing.credit comm Function — service-to-service wallet credit (wrapper over stapel_billing.services.credit), for a peer that rewards or compensates a user (a referral bonus, a goodwill grant). Service-to-service only: there is no user-facing route to it, the same posture as billing.debit. idempotency_key is REQUIRED and unique per wallet across every ledger row: comm delivery is at-least-once and a retry with the same key returns the original transaction (same transaction_id, the balance it left) instead of crediting twice. A key already spent on a different operation (another amount, or a debit) answers ok=false, reason=idempotency_conflict, and moves nothing. source is the credit lot's LotSource (only the two a peer may claim: grant, adjustment); type mirrors stapel_billing.models.TransactionType. expires_at (ISO 8601, in the future; a naive value is read as UTC) makes the lot die at that moment; omitted, it never expires. Returns {"ok": bool, "balance": int|null, "reason": str|null, "transaction_id"?: str}; reason is one of user_unknown, user_inactive, invalid_expires_at, idempotency_conflict.

identity.description: Who user_id is, so a user billing has not met yet (a referee who just signed up) can be materialised instead of refused. Only these keys; a bare id never creates a row.
